title: The registration calendar, and a gap
subtitle: Texas says it is now delivering license-portal registrations it never forwarded
alt: Timeline of Texas voter registration for the November 3, 2026 election. Since September 2020, after voting rights groups sued the state, Texans renewing a driver's license or updating an address online could also register to vote through the same Department of Public Safety portal; about 6 million Texans used it between 2020 and 2024. Last week the secretary of state's office learned that an unknown number of those applications were never sent on to county voter registrars because the records were incomplete. On September 22 the state said it would begin delivering the unsent registrations to counties overnight. The registration deadline is October 5. Early voting runs October 19 through October 30. Election Day is November 3.
source: Texas secretary of state's office and DPS, via KXAN; Texas election calendar
